protocol: Post-hoc assistant semantic reannotation of the existing 24 cases after prior scores were available. Images, numbered boxes and previous context notes inspected; labels use image/context reasoning, not score thresholds. Not independent, blinded, or a new benchmark. Equivalent subset remains provisional until independent human review.

control_categories.F: visually judged false for this directed pair

notes.riding_1: Visible cyclist/bicycle; riding on preserves action. Mounted adds a lexical ambiguity. Passive/carrying expressions reverse roles.
notes.riding_2: Tiny occupant in bus; mounted on is not the bus occupancy relation. Small original regions prevent strict certification.
notes.riding_3: Street cyclist too small for strict independent semantic and control confirmation.
notes.riding_4: Boat occupancy differs from mounted on; eating cannot be firmly excluded at this scale.
notes.holding_1: Coarse object region and hand overlap do not establish equivalence to grasping all contents.
notes.holding_2: Surfboard held visibly, but grasping/holding onto impose grip emphasis not established at displayed resolution.
notes.holding_3: Umbrella handle visibly held; holding onto preserves relation, grasping adds grip emphasis.
notes.holding_4: Small tennis equipment and hand are uncertain.
notes.on_1: Chair on lawn; top placement matches, resting adds static support emphasis.
notes.on_2: Object on tabletop; top placement matches, resting adds state emphasis.
notes.on_3: Person stands on sand; resting suggests a different human state.
notes.on_4: Chair on floor; top placement matches, resting adds state emphasis.
notes.over_1: Tree crown extends over grass; above/higher can omit coverage meaning.
notes.over_2: Sky above sea; higher than adds a global height comparison.
notes.over_3: Sky above train; higher than differs in scope.
notes.over_4: Ceiling above floor; higher than is comparative rather than placement.
notes.beside_1: Adjacent people; eating by a person cannot be certified absent merely from these boxes.
notes.beside_2: Person/large sea region mixes distance and depth; adjacency uncertain.
notes.beside_3: Adjacent appliances; next to preserves placement, alongside adds alignment emphasis.
notes.beside_4: Adjacent train regions; alongside adds parallel alignment.
notes.in_front_of_1: Ahead of implies order/motion; foreground is related but coarsely framed.
notes.in_front_of_2: Overlapping foreground/background frames leave depth uncertain.
notes.in_front_of_3: Front barrier and vehicle have visible occlusion; foreground preserves viewpoint relation.
notes.in_front_of_4: Crowded overlapping large regions; depth uncertain, regardless of positive model margin.
